contribution_requirements: Follow SKILL.md workflow and craft rules exactly (C:\Users\k64163939\.kiro\skills\anatomy\SKILL.md, references\craft.md, kit.md sections 1-12, motion.md, verify.md). Solids, never wireframes. Four-tone shading via the kit. Tone hierarchy: base and walls lo, structure mid, car hi, exactly one lit accent (the traction sheave). No leader lines or labels in the drawing (at most one engraved label). Every line ends on something. No pipe, rope or cable passes through anything. Depth order proved by A.settle and the audit, never hand-tuned keys. Textures end on edges or fade. Every part sits on another part. Light theme is the primary design target. Every number shown comes from model.mjs.
key_patterns: Copy the helper pattern from examples\arcade-cabinet\build.mjs lines 41-170 (prismPaths, board, prism, box, turned, disc, ball, planeMatrix, cable): each helper records its shape into the one A.recorder as it puts its item. Recorder: A.recorder(P, { order: ['travel'], spring: {} }). Moving items set ride:'travel' plus their own move (car [0,0,1120], CWT [0,0,-1120], cable loop [0,0,560]); piece = highlight group. Settle with A.settle(R, P, { states: A.uniformStates(56) }), sort by key, emit <g class="it" data-name data-group data-k data-m data-ride>, end with A.auditOrExit(R, P, { frames: A.uniformStates(112), apart: true, crowd: CROWD_OK }). The page re-sorts nodes every frame by key + lift*share (Raptor live.js place(), line ~144). Vertical rope runs whose length changes: one full-length tubePieces chunk inside a clip whose path has data-hold, moved with the ride's translate, plus k.holdStill(el,[dx,dy]), recorded as A.slide(F, 0, restLength, r) with F.a pointing down from the fixed end (craft.md 'Rod out of a gland'). Rotating sheaves: marks drawn in a face-plane group (planeMatrix) with an inner <g transform=rotate(θ)> set by live.js from model angles. Displays: <text> in face planes, fitted to their windows. Parts buttons under the card follow the Raptor's rp-part buttons (raptor build.mjs ~line 922).
